scope.statement: For a finite label set of size n>=2, finite planar option sets O_i and real D, a selection with every cross-label distance in [1,D) exists iff the graph with same-label edges and cross-label conflicts d<1 or d>=D has an independent transversal.
scope.domain: Exact Fraction arithmetic; seven fixed rational planar points; all one- and two-option domains for ordered two-label systems, 125 selected three-label systems, and an empty-class control.
scope.limitations: Checks only the equivalence and its boundary conventions. Does not derive palettes for canonical global minimizers, audit interval arithmetic, or verify the external 132/175-coordinate controls.

result: Independent proof reconstruction establishes the stated finite equivalence; exact rational boundary regressions agree with direct pair checks. Candidate remains unreviewed and no theorem-state is changed.
remaining_questions: Derive complete finite planar palettes with a transversal for every sufficiently large triangle-free global minimizer, or prove another complete-source strict-diameter contradiction.
